evaluation: budget-sized lanes (int page, long tick, Control): lookup and LRU victim by one linear scan, O(budget) with budget default 8; no allocation once grown
rationale: LeetCode 146 (hash map + doubly linked list) gives O(1) but allocates nodes and costs more than an 8-slot scan; CLOCK (M3BoundedCache) is O(1) amortized but approximate, and the release order is visible to the client, so exact LRU wins at this size

evaluation: selection order array grows by doubling with a count lane: n selections cost O(n) amortized instead of O(n^2) copies; removal is one in-place shift; getSelection copies the selected prefix (O(k))
rationale: stock reallocates GalleryItem[] on every selected or deselected item and hands out its internal array; a linked list would allocate per item and lose O(1) indexing; the bit flags stay the single membership truth (one model)
